Applications with payment can be mailed, dropped off, or brought in person to: City Hall
Treasurer, 400 La Crosse Street, La Crosse WI, 54601. Checks are payable to La Crosse City
Treasurer. Once your payment is made, permit sticker(s) will be provided or mailed to you. The
payment is valid for the 2027 season but the sticker will be reusable. The sticker must be placed
on the windshield for access. If you have questions, please call Refuse & Recycling office at
608-789-7508, option 4.
